verdicts.reason: A: the headline is large and centred, but the wind-turbine hero icon has shrunk to a tiny thumbnail in a strip along the bottom, next to squashed fragments of the colour triangles. One long diagonal line cuts through a big empty middle, so the focal image is lost and the layout feels unplanned. B is worse: the icon and the triangles are crushed into a tiny strip on the left, the headline is pushed off-centre to the right, and two stray lines float in a large dead lower half, so the composition is lopsided and the brand imagery is unrecognisable.
